computer_away: The assistant's computer is not connected
sending_now: This message is being sent right now. Try again in a moment.
busy: Waits for this conversation's current work to finish, then goes in
behind: Waits behind earlier messages that did not go in
may_have_gone_in: It may already have gone in. Check the conversation before you retry
not_saved: This could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
awaiting_receipt: Sent; waiting for the conversation to confirm it got it. If no confirmation comes in time it stops waiting and nothing is sent twice
behind_unconfirmed: Waits behind a message whose delivery is not confirmed yet; goes in once that one is confirmed or times out
switch_pending: Waits while this conversation moves to another engine; goes in once that is done
receipt_expired: No confirmation came in time, so it left the send queue and later messages went on. It may have gone in: check the conversation, then Retry or Delete
not_expired: This message is still on its way or was already handled; nothing was changed
